governance.anti_p_hacking: All parameters, target manifests, seed ranges, and evaluation criteria are frozen prior to cohort execution. Parameter escalation is strictly prohibited.
governance.policy_leakage_prohibition: Zero access to neuron labels, turn_right, routes, goal coordinates, or environment IDs in plasticity updates or consequence signals.

equations.modulatory_update: delta_W_ij(t) = eta * g_t * e_ij(t) - gamma * delta_W_ij(t-1)
equations.efficacy_mapping: W_effective_ij(t) = S_ij * alpha_ij(t) where S_ij is immutable measured anatomical synapse count
equations.consequence_signal: contact > 0 -> g_t = 0.0 (HOLD); contact cleared -> g_t = +1.0 (REINFORCE); ITI -> 0.0

success_criteria.criterion_1_dna02_increase: Mean right DNa02 post-induction evoked rate exceeds baseline by a statistically significant paired effect
success_criteria.criterion_2_exec_strength: turn_right activation strength under Readout C exceeds >0.05 in a substantial fraction of seeds
success_criteria.criterion_3_exceeds_old_rule: Q4 materially outperforms Q1 old-rule control
success_criteria.criterion_4_sham_negative: Q5 matched sham produces <0.05 Hz right DNa02 recruitment
success_criteria.criterion_5_reinforcement_required: Q6 no-reinforcement control does not reproduce the learned effect
success_criteria.criterion_6_alpha_reset: Resetting alpha -> 1.0 abolishes the acquired right-steering response
success_criteria.criterion_7_left_preserved: Existing left tactile steering recruitment is preserved within +-5%
success_criteria.criterion_8_off_target_safe: Whole-brain firing rate divergence outside target pathways remains within +-10%
success_criteria.criterion_9_non_saturation: Learning does not require 100% saturation of all target bounds
